mapper.select: SELECT result.id, CAST(result.clauses AS text) AS clauses, CAST(result.reviews AS text) AS reviews, result.evidence_gaps FROM orchestrator_runs AS run JOIN policy_rag_results AS result ON CAST(result.id AS text) = run.result_data ->> 'policyRagResultId' WHERE run.case_id = #{caseId} AND run.orchestrator_runs_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY run.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST, run.id DESC LIMIT 1
